page_title: EMP 0-0 MON | Empoli v Monza 17/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+2' We are about to witness a substitution. Liberato Cacace (Empoli) is replacing Giuseppe Pezzella.
90+1' Andrea Petagna (Monza) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
87' A corner kick by Empoli is thwarted by the well prepared Semuel Pizzignacco (Monza).

87' Ola Solbakken (Empoli) bursts inside the box, beats two defenders and produces a strike from the penalty spot. The shot has power, but lacks precision and the goalkeeper stops it easily. The scoreline remains the same. Empoli get a corner.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Emmanuel Ekong (Empoli) is coming onto the pitch as Jacopo Fazzini cannot continue after picking up an injury.
85' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Francesco Caputo (Empoli) replacing Lorenzo Colombo.
85' The referee signals a substitution. Nicolas Haas (Empoli) is brought on as a substitute for Youssef Maleh.
82' Monza keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
78' Liam Henderson (Empoli) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
77' Great solo effort from Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort rose just over the bar.

74' Warren Bondo (Monza) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
74' Now Monza have a corner.
74' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Monza earn a corner.
70' The referee blows for a cooling break.
69' Alessandro Nesta prepares a substitution. Samuele Vignato is replaced by Gianluca Caprari (Monza).
69' Roberto D'Aversa decides to make a substitution. Sebastiano Esposito will be replaced by Ola Solbakken (Empoli).
67' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Luca Caldirola (Monza) duly receives a yellow card.
65' Michael Fabbri interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Samuele Vignato (Monza).
62' Substitution. Daniel Maldini walks off the pitch and Dany Mota (Monza) comes on as a substitute.
60' The resulting corner, taken by Liam Henderson (Empoli), comes to nothing.

60' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Empoli) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Empoli are awarded a corner kick.
56' Empoli fail to score from a corner as Semuel Pizzignacco (Monza) leaps to collect the ball.
56' The ball is cleared after Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Empoli win a corner kick.
55' Liam Henderson (Empoli) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

55' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) slams the ball from a long-range free kick. He should have curled it higher to avoid hitting the wall. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Empoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
52' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) is adjudged offside.
49' Liam Henderson (Empoli) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
49' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) collects an inch-perfect pass and strikes the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Empoli.
48' Michael Fabbri shows a yellow card to Daniel Maldini (Monza) for his blatant foul.
48' A corner kick by Monza is thwarted by the well prepared Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach (Empoli).
48' Andrea Petagna (Monza) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Monza.
47' Daniel Maldini (Monza) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
46' Alessandro Nesta has made a change at the break. Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) has come on in place of Matteo Pessina.
46' The second half has just started.
45+7' Michael Fabbri has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+7' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Empoli.
45+5' Samuele Vignato (Monza) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

45+1' What an opportunity! Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker wide of the left post.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
43' Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach (Empoli) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.

40' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful low volley was directed towards the middle of the net, but Semuel Pizzignacco was alert and made an astonishing save!
40' Andrea Petagna (Monza) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
36' Andrea Petagna (Monza) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee decides to stop play.
36' The free kick into the penalty area from Liam Henderson (Empoli) is cleared.
33' Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach (Empoli) tackles a bit over-zealously and Michael Fabbri blows for a foul.
28' Semuel Pizzignacco (Monza) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
25' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
24' Semuel Pizzignacco (Monza) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
24' Matteo Pessina (Monza) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
22' Matteo Pessina (Monza) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
20' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
16' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is out of play. Monza will take a throw-in.
12' A quickly taken corner by Empoli.

12' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. Empoli will take a corner kick.
11' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) picks up the ball and goes on a great solo run. He decides to shoot from mid-range but his attempt is comfortably blocked by a defender.
10' The foul by Sebastian Walukiewicz (Empoli) was seen by Michael Fabbri who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
9' Dangerous play by Andrea Petagna (Monza). Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for a foul.
8' Daniel Maldini (Monza) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well wide of the left post.
7' Liam Henderson (Empoli) sends in a cross from a long-range free kick. However, his effort lacks accuracy and the ball sails off the pitch.
6' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
4' Andrea Petagna (Monza) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
2' Andrea Petagna (Monza) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. It's a throw-in for Empoli.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Empoli will have the kick-off.
Michael Fabbri will officiate today.
